importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!*SRWLockExclusive: bridge state lock; the safe point only tries it
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!*VectoredExceptionHandler: fault-safe probe for the caller's buffers (src/runtime/probe.cpp)
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetLastError, Sleep, Virtua: mingw-w64 DLL start-up: pseudo-relocation fix-up (VirtualQuery/VirtualProtect) and the start-up lock
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-runtime: mingw-w64 DLL start-up: static constructors (_initterm) and the DLL's own atexit table
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-stdio: mingw-w64 pseudo-relocation error report to stderr before abort; never reached on a valid image
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-private: memory routines (UCRT), replacing the former freestanding copies
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateThread, CreateEventW,: input service thread: started only by start_live() (module start-up thread or a host test), stopped and joined by stop_live(); never from DllMain
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateWaitableTimerExW, Set: input service tick (8 ms, high-resolution waitable timer; no timeBeginPeriod)
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!QueryPerformanceCounter, Qu: input service clock and the per-run inventory session id
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetSystemDirectoryW, LoadLi: input service: System32 xinput1_4.dll by full path (XInputGetState), and hid.dll/cfgmgr32.dll preloaded from System32 so SDL's base-name loads resolve to System32 modules
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateSemaphoreW, ReleaseSe: SDL2 threads and synchronisation (thread/windows); SDL TLS is TlsAlloc-based, no TLS directory
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!RaiseException, IsDebuggerP: SDL2 names its threads for an attached debugger (exception 0x406D1388 only when a debugger is present)
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateFileA, CreateFileW, R: SDL2 HIDAPI opens and reads HID game controllers (\\?\hid# device paths); RWops file code is linked whole-object but not reached by the input path
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetFileSizeEx, GetFileTime,: SDL2 RWops/HIDAPI file helpers, linked whole-object (x64 mingw keeps .pdata, so --gc-sections cannot drop unused functions); not reached by the input path
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!LoadLibraryA, LoadLibraryW,: SDL2 loadso and HIDAPI/XInput loaders (hid.dll, cfgmgr32.dll, XInput1_4.dll by base name: already loaded from System32 by the input service before SDL_Init)
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!FormatMessageW, LocalFree,: SDL2 error strings and SDL_Log output to an attached debugger
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetEnvironmentVariableA, Se: SDL2 SDL_getenv (hint fallback; every hint the service uses is set at override priority, so the environment cannot change it) and SDL_setenv (linked, never called)
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetSystemInfo, GlobalMemory: SDL2 CPU/RAM info and Windows version checks
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!ExitProcess, TerminateProce: SDL2 SDL_ExitProcess (TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess())), reachable only from SDL's assertion handler; SDL_ASSERT_LEVEL is 0, so no SDL_assert* expands to a call (test_coop_input_service checks no code calls SDL_ReportAssertion)
importReasons.ADVAPI32.dll!RegOpenKeyExW, RegQueryValu: SDL2 reads joystick OEM names from the registry (read-only)
importReasons.ole32.dll!CoInitializeEx, CoCreateInstan: SDL2 DirectInput joystick driver (CLSID_DirectInput8 via COM) on the input service thread
importReasons.USER32.dll: SDL2 message-only windows for device-change notification (joystick and HIDAPI), their message loop and timers; GetDoubleClickTime belongs to SDL mouse code linked through SDL events and is not used
importReasons.WINMM.dll!timeBeginPeriod, timeEndPeriod: SDL2 timer resolution; the service sets SDL_TIMER_RESOLUTION=0 at override priority, so SDL never changes the system timer
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-math: SDL2 SDL_stdlib math wrappers, linked whole-object; the input service uses SSE sqrt inline; guest steering maths (atan2, sin, cos, sqrt) on the co-op thread, never in a detour
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-convert, api-ms-win-crt-s: SDL2 string/stdlib helpers (SDL_strtol, SDL_qsort, controller mapping parsing)
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-filesystem!_lock_file, _u: SDL2 stdio RWops (UCRT file locks), linked whole-object; not reached by the input path
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-stdio!fclose, ferror, ffl: SDL2 stdio RWops and the assertion prompt (fgets), linked whole-object; the prompt is unreachable with SDL_ASSERT_LEVEL 0
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-runtime!_errno, signal, s: SDL2 errno text, and SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers in SDL_QuitInit, which the service turns off (SDL_NO_SIGNAL_HANDLERS=1 at override priority) so the game's signal handling is never touched
importReasons.api-ms-win-crt-private!memmove, strchr,: memory and string routines (UCRT) used by SDL2
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, T: MinHook 1.3.4 (patch layer, src/patch/): MH_ApplyQueued lists this process's threads, suspends every other thread while the 5-byte jumps are written or restored, and moves an instruction pointer that sits in the overwritten bytes into (or back out of) the trampoline (CONTEXT_CONTROL only). Linked; nothing calls the patch layer until the module boot wires it
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!VirtualAlloc, VirtualFree,: MinHook: one 4 KiB executable buffer per hooked region, searched within 1 GiB of the site (VirtualQuery over the address space, allocation granularity from GetSystemInfo); freed only for hooks that were never enabled
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!VirtualProtect, FlushInstru: MinHook: makes the 5 bytes at a site writable for the jump (or its restore), restores the protection and flushes the instruction cache
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!HeapCreate, HeapDestroy, He: MinHook: its private heap for the hook records and the thread list. The list is allocated before any thread is suspended and freed after they resume, and it is not the process heap, so a suspended thread holding the process heap lock cannot deadlock the install
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetCurrentProcessId, GetCur: MinHook: thread enumeration filters on this process and skips the calling thread; Sleep(0/1) backs off its spin lock; GetModuleHandleW/GetProcAddress belong to MH_CreateHookApi, which the patch layer never calls (hook.c is one object)
importReasons.USER32.dll!GetAsyncKeyState, GetForegrou: input service keyboard reader (src/input/keyboard_live.cpp): whether this process owns the foreground window, then the state of single virtual keys named by the keyboard seat's bindings (all keys only during a capture); no hook, no raw input
importReasons.USER32.dll!PeekMessageW, DispatchMessage: input service thread (src/input/input_service.cpp): drains its own thread's message queue without blocking, at most 64 messages per tick, so SDL's message-only device-notification windows (joystick and HIDAPI hot-plug with video off) receive their messages
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!AcquireSRWLockShared, Relea: boot status (src/boot/boot.cpp): bridge calls read the four status words under a shared lock; writers hold it to copy them
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!CreateMutexW: boot instance guard (src/boot/boot.cpp): one named per-process mutex (Local\IvaliceLegacyCoop_<pid>), held for the life of the process, so a second copy of the module stays inert
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!OpenMutexW, SetLastError: Ivalice Together detection (src/boot/together_detect.cpp): opens the other mod's per-process mutexes for SYNCHRONIZE only to learn whether they exist, closes them at once; only ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND counts as absent
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetFileAttributesW: Ivalice Together detection (src/boot/together_detect.cpp): whether the other mod's files exist in the game's x64 folder; nothing is opened
importReasons.KERNEL32.dll!GetModuleFileNameW: boot (src/boot/boot.cpp): the game executable's folder, for the Together file markers and the read-only settings file

tls.why: only the mingw-w64 CRT tlssup markers may form a TLS template; thread_local is forbidden (g++ 16.2 compiles it to native TLS: a .tls template and gs:[0x58] reads; older toolchains used emutls)
